plans.name: open-cases
plans.sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM clinlims.micro_case WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at

plans.name: sibling-cases-by-sample
plans.sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM clinlims.micro_case WHERE sample_item_id IN (:sampleItemIds) ORDER BY sample_item_id, workflow_type

plans.name: isolates-by-case
plans.sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM clinlims.micro_isolate WHERE case_id IN (:caseIds) ORDER BY case_id, isolate_label

plans.name: ast-runs-by-isolate
plans.sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM clinlims.micro_ast_run WHERE isolate_id IN (:isolateIds) ORDER BY isolate_id, started_at, id

plans.name: communications-by-case
plans.sqlTemplate: SELECT * FROM clinlims.micro_critical_communication WHERE case_id IN (:caseIds) ORDER BY case_id, communicated_at
